exposure: Glycated haemoglobin (HbA1c) at diagnosis of GDM
cohort: The study included 1244 women diagnosed with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM).
finding: Measurements of HbA1c at GDM diagnosis and at 36 weeks gestation were independently associated with an increased risk of large-for-gestation (LGA) babies and neonatal hypoglycaemia.
